upstream.name: rclone/rclone
upstream.architecture: Go storage provider abstraction with backend remotes, copy/sync/check commands, fs provider contracts, filter rules, hash utilities, checksums, and fstest integration suites.

benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow blob-filtered upstream clone at .upstream-cache/rclone; counted with git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD and targeted reads of Makefile, COPYING, fs/filter, fs/hash, and fs/operations check/copy tests.

runnerStatus.reason: The full upstream runner was not executed in this modest lane run. rclone's Makefile quick target runs RCLONE_CONFIG="/notfound" go test ./..., while the full test target builds rclone and fstest/test_all before running provider integration remotes. That would require building/downloading the Go module graph and may exercise remote/backend integration fixtures, so this lane records a cloned static inventory rather than upstream pass parity.

probes.result: counted 327 Go test files and 836 testdata paths without running the upstream Go suite

mappedSemantics: fs/filter GlobPathToRegexp path semantics for leading slash anchoring, *, **, ?, brace alternation, and invalid glob errors.
Sync planning skips objects excluded by filter rules.
Checksum/size change detection remains native PHP without shelling out.
WordPress backup fixture filters uploads, WXR exports, and SQL dumps while excluding cache/log/source files.
fs/hash Set count, add, overlap, subset, get-one, array ordering, string formatting, and type alias parsing for MD5/SHA-1/none.
fs/hash MultiHasher fixtures for MD5, SHA-1, CRC-32, SHA-256, and SHA-512 on upstream byte vectors and empty input.
fs/operations check-style classification reports matching, differing, missing-on-source, and missing-on-destination objects with rclone combined sigils.
fs/operations check one-way mode ignores destination-only objects.
fs/operations copy-style changed path copying is idempotent and honors WordPress backup filter rules.
fs/operations ParseSumFile accepts md5sum-style two-space and space-star separators, preserves path whitespace, lowercases sums, skips malformed lines, and ignores duplicate filenames.
fs/operations HashLister/HashSumStream output hash values in md5sum-compatible `hash  path` lines, including base64 stream output for stdin-style input.
cmd/lsf path/size/hash formatting maps default `p`, `ps`, `hp`, files-only, dirs-only, separator, recurse, and directory slash behavior for local-style listings.
benchmarkDenominator.warning: This replaces the seed denominator with a cloned static inventory, not upstream runner parity. Native PHP progress maps 14 focused lane tests against a 327-Go-test-file upstream denominator.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native in-memory provider contract with object metadata, copy, list, checksum sync planning, rclone-style path filter rules, hash set/type aliases, multi-hashing, check report sigils, one-way checks, filtered copy-changed planning, ParseSumFile-style checksum parsing, HashLister/HashSumStream-style output, and lsf path/size/hash formatting.

wordpressScenario: Portable WordPress backup/import/export sync for shared hosts and cloud storage providers, including filtered uploads, WXR exports, SQL dumps, checksum manifests, and excluded cache/log/source artifacts.
nextTask: Map deeper fs provider contract behavior, lsjson output, or checksum verification against parsed sum files.
